run_bleu_scoring: run BLEU scoring of generated translations against reference translations using the fairseq CLI
run_corpus_bleu_with_sacrebleu: run corpus-level BLEU scoring using sacrebleu by passing the --sacrebleu flag to the CLI
run_sentence_bleu: run sentence-level BLEU scoring with +1 smoothing by passing the --sentence-bleu flag
run_case_insensitive_bleu: run case-insensitive BLEU scoring by passing the --ignore-case flag to the CLI
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that configures argparse arguments for BLEU scoring options
